name: Zhalfirins
description: Army that dispatched the remaining praetors.

description_citations.text: "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mangara arrives in Jamuraa after meeting Jolrael and Kaervek and brokers peace among the nations, settling the Zhalfir-Femeref border with a buffer zone of Quirion Elves.
timeline.quote: Mangara brokered peace between the rival nations

citation.text: "Mangara's Harmony", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins celebrate with drums that Phyrexia is defeated while Teferi mourns at a grassy hill.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia lies broken and defeated beyond the reach of time.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 10: The Rhythms of Life" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins charge the Phyrexians and Teferi tells Koth the planes are swapping, with Zhalfir coming home.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth rallies the Mirrans and the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army.
timeline.quote: After only minutes on the field, the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army's forces

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi stops Jin-Gitaxias's war machine blades and a Zhalfirin warrior shatters the vat, dropping Jin-Gitaxias to be eaten by his own creations.
timeline.quote: Even smaller when his own creations start eating him.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi calls the retreat and the Zhalfirins fend off Phyrexians as the Mirrans pass through the portal.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 9: The Old Sins of New Phyrexia" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Teferi hears Wrenn's call; a few Zhalfirins were already roused by a strange song.
timeline.quote: Even before Teferi heard Wrenn's call, a few Zhalfirins were roused from sleep by a strange, otherworldly song.

citation.text: Distant Melody (March of the Machine Commander, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight push New Phyrexia into the knotted magic holding Zhalfir so the army can land; the reinforcements dispatch the remaining three praetors.
timeline.quote: The reinforcements dispatched the remaining three praetors

citation.text: "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The allies evacuate; New Phyrexia replaces Zhalfir in the planar tangle and phases out of existence while Zhalfir returns to the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia replaced Zhalfir in the planar tangle and phased out of existence, while Zhalfir returned to the Multiverse.

citation.text: "New Phyrexia-Zhalfir switch", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Visitors like their own wandering son, Teferi.
